title: Tilde Mining
description: A completely customizable hotkey vein mining mod!
body:
## Tilde Mining
Tilde Mining is a configurable vein mining mod that adds smarter block collection and more control over how mining works. It goes beyond basic vein mining with custom shape handling, directional logic, staircase support, and optional filtering for blocks you may not want included.

### Features:
- Configurable vein mining
- Custom shape-based block collection
- Directional mining logic
- Staircase up and down support
- Optional non-full block filtering
- More precise control over what gets mined
- Designed to be flexible and easy to configure
